Current evidence.ts:84-91:
  /** A quoted evaluation is backed when it is within EVAL_TOLERANCE_CP of a backed score in absolute value (either side's point of view), or, for mate in N, when N matches exactly. */
  backsEval(quote) { if ('mate' in quote) return this.mates.has(Math.abs(quote.mate)); const q = Math.abs(quote.cp); return this.cps.some((s) => Math.abs(s - q) <= EVAL_TOLERANCE_CP + 1e-9); }
